The '''2003–04 Bundesliga''' was the 41st season of the [[Bundesliga]], Germany's premier football league. It began on 1 August 2003 and concluded on 22 May 2004.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.worldfootball.net/competition/co12/se3146/all-matches/ |title=Bundesliga 2003/2004 » Schedule |website=WorldFootball.net |access-date=13 June 2020}}</ref>

==Teams==
Eighteen teams competed in the league&nbsp;– the top fifteen teams from the previous season and the three teams promoted from the [[2002–03 2. Bundesliga|2. Bundesliga]]. The promoted teams were [[SC Freiburg]], [[1. FC Köln]] and [[Eintracht Frankfurt]]. SC Freiburg and 1. FC Köln returned to the top flight after an absence of one year while Eintracht Frankfurt returned to the top fight after an absence of two years. They replaced [[Arminia Bielefeld]], [[1. FC Nürnberg]] and [[Energie Cottbus]], ending their top flight spells of one, two and three years respectively.
